priorRevision.reason: Normal browser mouse/touch users could not reliably reach or discover rotation.

rootCauses: The old SVG was 520×560 and exceeded the visible 469 px browser height.
The tested drag start and translated axis could lie below the real viewport.
Tests dispatched synthetic PointerEvent objects directly to the SVG and bypassed viewport hit testing.
There was no large independent rotation-ring hit area.
